description: cw for Codex: adds what `cw context` prints at the start of a session, and refuses, with the reason, a command with --no-verify or an edit of cw.toml, because Codex cannot ask from a hook. The git hooks decide about commits and pushes; this file does not.

hooks.command: if command -v cw >/dev/null 2>&1; then cw context; elif [ -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/cw.toml" ]; then echo "cw is not installed, so every commit and every push in this repository will be denied by its git hooks. The install instruction is at https://github.com/belevtsev/agent-workflows#install"; fi
if command -v cw >/dev/null 2>&1; then cw guard --host codex; fi
